description: Allocate a three-element int array in Java and use a for loop with grades.length to fill and print each slot.

steps.description: Allocate a three-element integer array with int[] grades = new int[3].
Loop i from 0 while i < grades.length, assigning grades[i] = 90 + i and printing grades[i].

steps.answer: Because grades.length is 3, i takes indices 0, 1, and 2, storing 90 at grades[0], 91 at grades[1], and 92 at grades[2].
steps.question: What indices does i take in the loop, and what values are stored in grades?

steps.description: Watch the first loop iteration assign 90 to grades[0] and print 90.

title: Creating, Populating, and Indexing an int Array
